## Problem

What problem should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable, testable behavior is defined.
- [ ] Tests are included or the reason for no tests is explained.
- [ ] Limitations are documented.
